azure-grand.boxText: In this transformative backyard design, we reimagined the space to elevate both relaxation and functionality. The new, larger pool is now perfectly centered on the upper deck, and a hot tub has been integrated into the lower deck, taking place of a former staircase. To maximize seating and flow, we relocated the second flight of stairs, opening the area for additional seating, and a large luxurious bed swing on the lower-level deck now offers a serene spot for relaxation and views of the pool. The outdoor kitchen is a true masterpiece, designed for entertaining with a grand variety of cooking appliances and stone finishes. The landscaping around the pool has been improved, softening the transition between all the areas. Welcome to Azure Grand!Read about Azure Grand in Martha Stewart's blog!

cedar-and-stone.boxText: Cedar & Stone is a stunning new pool house and landscape design for the ultimate summer retreat for a busy family with three boys. Bluff setbacks prevented a backyard build, so the pool house was thoughtfully placed to the side of the home, creating a private, sunken oasis.Featuring a dramatic arched entry, vaulted ceilings, and stone accents that echo the home's new exterior color palette, the structure houses a bathroom, changing room, outdoor kitchen, and shaded lounge. With ample dining and entertaining space, this elegant design blends functionality and style. A new roundabout driveway was added to allow room for the design.Accompanying the poolhouse is a pool boasting with water features, a poolside fire table, extra large hot tub, and a wood-burning fire pit set away from the pool area. Cedar & Stone is giving luxury at its finest."This is amazing! I like that even though the poolhouse is adjacent to the home due to site restrictions, it still was designed to fit in. The wood arch in the front of the pool house is carried through to the stone on the back side. Nice work!" – NARI

hidden: Landscape Design and Landscaping in MN
cool-california.boxText: Cool California transformed the underside of an existing deck into a protected outdoor kitchen and lounge, complete with a louvered pergola, see-through fireplace, patio, and fire pit.The homeowners wanted an all-season space for cooking, dining, and entertaining, with seamless access from the home. A kitchen with a pass-through window to the basement bar, a wood-burning fireplace, and thoughtfully arranged furniture create functional, flowing zones.California-Scandinavian materials—white stucco, stained wood, cool stone, and custom stone veneer—blend with clean lines, arches, and curves. Innovative craftsmanship included precise island framing, detailed window trim, concealed drainage, and a shored-up foundation."This project is thoughtful and highly functional reimagining of under-deck space, turning it into a versatile outdoor living area. Impressive craftsmanship in custom stone veneer, curved stucco detailing, and concealed drainage systems. The design team successfully combined aesthetics, innovation, and craftsmanship to create a seamless all-season extension of the home that maximizes every inch of space." – NARIRivard Stone Contractor Competition 2025 1st Place Winner

hidden: Pool house and pool design in MN
countryside-collective.boxText: The Countryside Collective project transformed an empty backyard into a luxurious retreat, centered around a swim-up bar inspired pool and custom water features. A sunken pool house, hot tub, and bubbling rock elements create a layered, immersive experience, complemented by a cozy fire and lounge area.Turf squares add playful texture, while porcelain pool decking stays cool underfoot. Strategically placed aspen trees and other plantings provide visual interest in every season. This design balances elegance, entertainment, and relaxation—a backyard perfect for gathering, unwinding, and enjoying the countryside."The craftsmenship is VERY evident in the work you did. BRAVO." – NARI

ember-spa.boxText: Ember Spa began as a DIY remodel that quickly proved too complex. The homeowners turned to our team mid-demo for professional design and expert installation to bring their vision to life. The "before" images pictured below were taken when we stepped in.The existing bathroom featured a very small, leaking shower, as well as an outdated, low-height toilet and vanity. They sought a more accessible, open, and modernized space. To address their needs, we installed a curb-less shower in a new location for easy, trip-free access, allowing for a seamless transition into the shower area. A new washer and dryer were integrated into the bathroom design for added convenience, neatly tucked behind a sliding door to maximize space.The homeowners also desired a spacious bath where they could relax and lounge. To fulfill this, we incorporated a generously sized free standing bath that comfortably fits two. Overall, the bathroom now boasts a cleaner, updated look, aligning perfectly with the homeowners' vision for both functionality and style."Major improvement." – NARI

entertaining-elegance.boxText: This thoughtfully designed lower-level remodel transformed the space into a bright and welcoming extension of the home. Featuring a full entertaining kitchen and bar, custom media wall, spa-inspired bath, functional mudroom entry, and seamless walkout access, every detail was created for comfort and connection. Elevated finishes, smart storage, and layered lighting make this lower level ideal for hosting guests, relaxing, and everyday living.

garden-grandeur.boxText: Garden Grandeur started from scratch as a bare, boring backyard with zero design elements. The homeowners dreamt of having an ultimate gathering spot, perfect to host their family and large circle of friends. The project transformed the entire space into an ultimate hangout space featuring a cohesive design with a pool, retaining walls, patio, and fire pit, all connected by clear pathways that enhance both functionality and flow.The use of natural stone and warm tones ensured a timeless and elegant look, creating an inviting atmosphere for various activities and gatherings. The homeowners greatly enjoy flowers and plants, so extensive landscaping was necessary for project completion.Read about Garden Grandeur in Martha Stewart's blog!

heart-of-home.boxText: Built in 1992, this lakeside home was ready for a full renovation to match its scenic setting and the demands of modern living. The original layout felt dated and inefficient, so the remodel opened the space by replacing a pantry closet with a sleek pantry cabinet and adding a large window above the sink to flood the kitchen with light and views. An oversized closet became a stylish wet bar and butler's pantry in rich alder, now a walk-through between the dining and living areas. Warm white oak floors, contrasting cabinetry, honed Borghini marble, and soapstone counters complete the sophisticated yet inviting kitchen design. The bathroom, laundry room, sitting room, front entry, and dining area were also updated in the home remodel. Welcome to Heart of Home. "This was a huge transformation compared to the original home. LOVE LOVE LOVE the space plan of the walk through bar/pantry between the living and dining rooms. It's truly show stopping and sets your project apart." – NARI

inside-out.boxText: This backyard retreat was designed to extend the home's living space outdoors with a vaulted screened porch, stone fireplace, outdoor kitchen, custom pool and spa, and multiple gathering areas. Surrounded by mature trees and natural stone accents, the design creates a seamless connection between luxury outdoor living and the beauty of the surrounding landscape.

hidden: Minnesota Living Wall Landscape Architecture – Mom’s Design Build
living-wall.boxText: This comprehensive landscape design featuring a pool, patio, fire area, retaining wall, and extensive planting was made complete with a stunning living wall as the backdrop of the pool's diving board. These homeowners enjoy their time in the sun, and also take in Minnesota summer nights next to the fire enjoying the sound of the pool's water features.

hidden: Patio and Exterior Addition Design in MN
magnolia-vista.boxText: The Magnolia Vista project involved working with wonderful homeowners in a new development with minimal established trees. The main goal was to create a comfortable and private outdoor space, ideal for entertaining. A pergola was designed to provide comfort overhead while allowing natural light to filter through the windows into the adjacent space. Additionally, a look-through wall was strategically placed to beautifully frame a magnolia tree beyond, adding to the overall aesthetic and ambiance of the space.

modern-mood.boxText: The homeowners, residing in a 1990s home, sought to update their primary bathroom to create a fresh, open space that still felt warm and cozy. The existing layout presented several challenges, including an undesirable first view of the toilet as you entered the room. They also wanted to reconfigure the tub and enlarge the shower for a more functional and luxurious experience. Additionally, the current vanity placement caused problems, as the door would frequently collide with someone using the sink.We rotated the tub 90 degrees to allow for more openness and room for the new toilet location. We changed the built in standard size tub to a deep freestanding tub with waterfall filler. The vanity was moved away from the entrance, helping with the flow in and out of the room. We also built a dedicated space for seating in the shower, along with convenient niches for shampoo and soap.

neighborhood-commons.boxText: Two neighboring families in the same community transformed their backyards into connected retreats, each with its own flair yet designed to flow seamlessly together. One inspired by the other, Neighborhood Commons are versatile landscape designs both complete with a hot tub, outdoor kitchen station, dining area, wood-burning firepit, and TV lounge for game nights. Both families prioritized open lawn space between their homes for their kids to play, blending their yards into one shared destination for the neighborhood to come relax and make memories together."This project beautifully delivers on the vision of an inviting, multifunctional outdoor living space. The design balances comfort, entertainment, and style while addressing significant site challenges with smart engineering solutions. The integration of features—pizza oven, hot tub, fire table, and pergola-covered firepit—creates a true destination for family and friends." – NARI's comments on Neighbor B's project

hidden: Minnesota Old World Charm Landscape Architecture – Mom’s Design Build
old-world-charm.boxText: This outdoor living space was designed to complement the home's architecture while creating inviting areas for gathering and relaxation. A custom pergola-covered kitchen, poolside lounge, and stone fireplace extend the home outdoors, while a front courtyard with a fountain adds a welcoming focal point. Thoughtful lighting, natural materials, and layered landscaping make the space beautiful and functional from day into evening.

pool-on-parade.boxText: This project was approached with the goal of creating distinctive, purpose-driven spaces that foster comfort—whether for everyday family use or larger gatherings. The design enables year-round enjoyment of the backyard while providing a sense of comfort and protection throughout each space. Learn more about this project in the Star Tribune!

private-resort.boxText: This private backyard retreat was designed to blend luxury indoor comfort with elevated outdoor living. From the resort-style pool and covered pavilion to the custom outdoor kitchen and fireplace lounge, every element creates a seamless space for entertaining and relaxation. Thoughtful lighting, layered landscaping, and architectural details ensure the home feels inviting and functional throughout the seasons.

rustic-farmhouse.boxText: This warm, rustic-inspired kitchen blends rich wood tones with clean, modern finishes for a balanced and inviting feel. Custom cabinetry, a statement wood backsplash detail, and a large central island create both visual interest and everyday functionality. Thoughtful lighting and durable materials make the space ideal for gathering, cooking, and daily living.

starry-sips-scenes.boxText: Starry Sips & Scenes transformed a once bare, unfinished basement into a luxury multi-use retreat. This Minnesota basement renovation features a speakeasy-style bar and lounge with dark-stained wood, textured brick, brass accents, and gold wallpaper, paired with a star-lit home theater boasting ten leather recliners and surround sound. Additional spaces include a guest suite with bedroom and bath, a mirrored workout room, and an infrared sauna for ultimate wellness. Perfect for entertaining, relaxing, and working out in style, this basement blends high-end design with functional living."This project manages to balance the complexity of a hyper-modern cinema room with the character of an old-school speakeasy, while still maintaining continuity through palette and materials. The black in the countertop ties seamlessly into the star ceiling of the theater, while brick appears both as a backsplash and as a feature wall at the base of the stairs. The brown tones in the theater carpet complement the dark wood stain of the cabinetry, and the brass and black metals repeat throughout the spaces, even connecting to more serene areas like the bath and bedroom. These thoughtful details allow a design filled with texture, color, pattern, and contrast to feel cohesive rather than chaotic." – NARI

sticks-and-stones.boxText: This thoughtfully designed outdoor retreat blends architectural structure with natural elements to create a timeless and inviting courtyard experience. A custom wood pergola anchors the space, providing filtered light and seasonal shade, while layered stonework, integrated water features, and lush planting beds add texture and movement throughout. Designed for multi-season enjoyment, the space transitions effortlessly from vibrant summer gatherings to cozy fall evenings around the fire. Soft lighting and carefully planned zones for lounging, dining, and entertaining extend the home outdoors, creating a refined yet relaxed environment that feels welcoming throughout Minnesota's changing seasons.

unlocking-luxury.boxText: This apartment community outdoor space blends modern design with inviting, hospitality-inspired amenities. Structured landscaping, layered hardscapes, and thoughtfully designed gathering areas create a welcoming environment for residents while enhancing the property's overall identity. Fire features, lounge spaces, and architectural lighting allow the space to transition beautifully through the seasons, offering comfort, functionality, and year-round visual appeal.

urban-retreat.boxText: This urban courtyard blends timeless architectural details with relaxed outdoor living. A custom pergola, natural stonework, and layered landscaping create defined spaces for dining, entertaining, and gathering while maintaining a cohesive flow. Warm textures, soft lighting, and thoughtful material selections make the space ideal for summer entertaining and cozy fall evenings, offering both beauty and functionality in a refined outdoor retreat.
